svg.title: Run the Race
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Matthew 11:28): People bent under bundles on their backs walk toward Jesus, who stands with His arms open. Caption: "In the towns of Galilee, Jesus calls out to tired people." Jesus says: "Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." Panel 2 (John 4:6): A medium view of Jesus sitting tired beside the stone rim of Jacob's well in the midday sun. Caption: "Jacob's well, about noon. Jesus is tired from the road." Note: ""Wearied" (John 4:6): the word for "labor" in Matthew 11:28." Panel 3 (Matthew 11:28-30): A man has set his bundle down on the ground and stands before Jesus, who holds out a wooden yoke to him. Caption: "He offers His own yoke." Jesus says: "Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me,". Jesus says: "For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light." Note: "Drawn: the load set down. "I will give you rest" (11:28)." Panel 4 (Hebrews 12:1-2): A runner in the foreground sets off down a long road toward the horizon, where Jesus sits in a burst of gold light. Caption: "Hebrews pictures the life of faith as a long race." Hebrews says: "let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus". Note: "Jesus, far off, is seated at the right hand of the throne of God (12:2)." Panel 5 (Isaiah 40:29-31): The runner, upright and striding out over the hills in warm morning light. Caption: "Isaiah, long before:". Isaiah says: "He gives power to the faint,". Isaiah says: "they shall run and not be weary;". The point: Come to Jesus tired, just as you are. He gives rest, and He gives power to the faint, so you may run the long race looking to Him (Matthew 11:28; Isaiah 40:29; Hebrews 12:1-2).
